Upstream: riakymch/exblas, commit
856130ebcfe906f519a623d57d1359e744e29042, src/common/.
Retained material: tests/results/main/ecosystem/raw/exblas/applied-compatibility.patch
and its identical member in the benchmark public source archive.

The pinned vectorclass.h umbrella header explicitly states GNU General
Public License 3.0 and has no or-later clause. The two patched headers,
vectorf256.h and vectori256.h, state GNU General Public License without a
version. All three complete original notice preambles are preserved in
SOURCE-NOTICES.txt. GPLv3 is used for these retained excerpts, consistently
with the explicit umbrella notice and GPLv3 section 14's rule permitting
a published version when no version is specified. No or-later grant is
asserted for the version-3.0 umbrella header.

GPL-3.0.txt contains the complete GNU GPLv3 text, including section 14.
Its source and hash are recorded in ../../SOURCES.json.

FloatLib's patch changes integer constant spellings; its hunks identify the
modified lines. The original notice headers are in SOURCE-NOTICES.txt.
These Vector Class excerpts use GPL-3.0-only, separately from ExBLAS's
top-level BSD-style license.
